interaction: A person stands at the kitchen sink and opens the kitchen faucet with the right hand. The right hand touches the faucet handle while the torso leans slightly over the sink. The left arm rests naturally by the body or near the counter, and both feet remain planted on the wooden floor. The person has short dark hair, a neutral focused expression, a gray shirt, blue jeans, and light sneakers. The kitchen has white cabinets, a dark countertop, a sink, a cooktop hood, a hanging towel, a trash bin, and a white radiator on the nearby wall.
